paragraphs: Rav Chana sent to Rav Mattana a hen whose bone had broken but whose brain membrane had not been pierced; Rav Mattana declared it permitted: Chullin 56a, near the end. Rav Bivi, in R. Chana's name: Jerusalem Berakhot.
